notes.title: Update 1.15 - UI Updates!
notes.content: - Simplifies the game UI for a more streamlined experience!

notes.title: Update 1.14 - Run without Steam
notes.content: ChatGuessGames is now more independent! For those of you that prefer to run it without Steam - that's now supported!

notes.title: Update 1.13 - The Retro Update!
notes.content:
Retro Streamers Rejoice, The Chat Guess Games Retro Update is here with:
- A new retro-only category!
- 500 more retro games to guess!
- Cute cat pixel art!

notes.title: Update 1.12 - Saving leaderboard state
notes.content:
The leaderboard will now remember it's state even when you close the game, so when you play again it will be right where you left it!
It will remember whether it was Open/Closed, what tab it was on Channels/Community, and what timeframe was selected All-time/This Month/Last Month.

notes.title: Update 1.11 - Time Limit Options!
notes.content: Some loved the 60 second time limit we trialed last week, others hated it, so we've added the option so you can choose whichever works for you!

notes.title: Update 1.0.8 - Magnify... Enhance
notes.content: There's now a magnify option in the menu to blow up the images to fit the area you've defined for hints!

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 - It's a big 'un
notes.content:
- Data improvements: Added more alternative games, removed some games that no one has ever heard of, removed a lot of images that give away the answer (ongoing)
- Bigger images to help our suffering mobile users :D
- Rounds are now 60 seconds because you're getting more image!
- Added an algorithm to stop images overlapping eachother where possible
- In-game leaderboard for all-time and the previous month
- Fixed an issue where the timer was animating off the wrong side of the screen
- Removed chat commands for scoreboard to provide a richer scoreboard in-game
- Clearer autoplay button text
- Fixes issue where image hints area sometimes couldn't be arranged

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - What are these, images for ants?
notes.content:
Features:

 Your community leaderboard, now in game
 Image size has been increased
 Round time decreased from 120 to 90 seconds
 Social links so you can easier contact us
 Balancing for answers

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
New Features:
Top Channel Leaderboard is now available in-game

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
New Features:
Added a field that allows guessing in-game instead of Twitch chat.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
New Features:
Added a green screen background option, requested by dual PC streamers

Improvements:
Improved wording in setup tips (learnt the difference bettween left and right!)
Improved connection speed
More prominent image borders
Current round will clear from screen if you disconnect
Added a link to the community page
